userDirection: 优先优化最可能展示在想来中国旅游的用户面前的网页。
selectionOrder: First qualify China-trip, transit itinerary, destination visit or concrete visitor-preparation intent.
Within qualified intent, assess real demand evidence: exact-page relevant impressions and independently verified search volume where available.
Then assess same-query ranking/CTR opportunity, content gap, implementation cost and current observation window.

tiers.2: Direct travel planning: trip cost, itinerary, destination/attraction logistics.
tiers.3: Concrete China visitor readiness: SIM/eSIM, payments, hotels, train, arrivals, navigation and transit-policy support. Query intent must distinguish residents, brands and corporate topics.
tiers.4: Hubs/supporting discovery; assess destination outcomes as well as source traffic.
tiers.5: Broad help with mixed audience: generic account verification/emergency assistance; maintenance and outcome tracking retained.

scopeRule: Audience relevance gates growth selection; priority does not mandate an edit today. Confirmed urgent technical/accuracy regressions may be fixed on any page.

exclude_or_separate: generic verification with no China-trip context

measurementRules: These intent classes are judgments from topics/wording, not measured audience identities or a guarantee of appearing to travelers.
Existing page clicks are proxy metrics until query×page evidence supports relevance.
GSC impressions are not market monthly search volume; page averages are not specific keyword ranks.
No exact-page query pairs for most pages; hidden queries and Ahrefs volume/KD remain unknown.
No universal rewrite from foreigner to tourist; serve distinct real intent and preserve truthful page scope.
Keep all previous action IDs, baselines, dates, states and observations; evaluate complete7/28day windows.
Current-year seasonal pages require prospective demand evidence before growth work; no automatic next-year URL/retitling.
